  pin EN input
  pin VIN input

# symbols (4)

R10 10k  lib=Device:R  fp=Resistor_SMD:R_0402_1005Metric
  Mpn1=RC0402FR-0710KL
  variant Lite dnp=yes
  variant Plus Value=4k7
U1 LM358  lib=Amp:Dual  fp=Package_SO:SOIC-8  units=1,2
  [unit 2] pin 5 alt=IN_ALT

# power symbols (2)

# no_connect (2)

nc U1.5 IN
